headlines.title: Republican-led House rejects Hegseth impeachment effort
headlines.description: The Republican-led House rejected a push to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over how he has carried out the war in Iran and other military hostilities.

headlines.title: Pro-Palestinian protesters pelt objects at Biden outside Irish university
headlines.description: Three men have been arrested after protesters pelted objects at former President Joe Biden during protests outside a university in Dublin, police in Ireland said.

headlines.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to large exchange of prisoners during peace talks
headlines.description: Russian, Ukrainian, and U.S. negotiators conclude their final day of U.S.-mediated peace talks in Abu Dhabi, their first face-to-face negotiations since February. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports on the latest developments, including potential agreements on prisoner exchanges and efforts to advance a broader peace deal.

headlines.title: Russia and Ukraine Agree on Large-Scale Prisoner Exchange
headlines.description: White House Special Envoy Jared Kushner says Russian and Ukraine have agreed on a large-scale prisoner exchange. The agreement follows two days of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi.

headlines.title: Who is Alice Huang, the Woman at the Center of Nvidia Scandal?
headlines.description: Alice Huang, the woman at the center of a suspected spy scandal involving Nvidia’s CEO Jensen Huang, is a former tech executive who used to work for China’s state television, but now questions are being raised about how Alice and Jensen first met. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports from Beijing for TODAY.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Kennedy family members seek to block construction of Trump’s arch
headlines.description: Nine family members seek to join a lawsuit against the arch, arguing it would cast a shadow over the site where some of their notable relatives are buried.

headlines.title: U.S. charges 3 men with plotting multiple terror attacks, including on British air base
headlines.description: One of the men helped direct the planned attack against the air base while he was in a U.S. prison, according to a Justice Department indictment.

headlines.title: GOP Rep. María Elvira Salazar wins re-election in Florida after clashing with Trump
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Salazar defeated her Democratic opponent in a heavily Hispanic, Miami-based district that Trump carried by 15 points in 2024.

headlines.title: How North Carolina emerged as one of Democrats’ biggest midterm bright spots: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki digs into battleground North Carolina’s massive midterm shift toward Democrats.

headlines.title: Bernie Sanders says he won’t support Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader
headlines.description: Sens. Sanders and Elissa Slotkin called for new leadership, but neither proposed an alternative. Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland is considering challenging Schumer.

headlines.title: House Republicans elect Rep. Jim Jordan as their next leader following election losses
headlines.description: Jim Jordan was elected House Republican leader over Steve Scalise, while John Thune will remain Senate Republican leader, despite a conservative push to delay.
